title: SecurityHardeningChecklist
description: Comprehensive DevSecOps and Penetration Testing hardening checklist for web applications and backend APIs.

controls.name: No Hardcoded Secrets
controls.description: Source files and configs must not contain plain-text passwords, JWT secrets, or private keys.

controls.name: Gitignore Env File
controls.description: .env and .env.* must be explicitly listed in .gitignore.

controls.name: Env Example Parity
controls.description: .env.example must mirror all keys with placeholder values and descriptive comments.

controls.name: Parameterized Database Queries
controls.description: Database queries must use parameterized ORM queries or prepared statements; no raw concatenation.

controls.name: Template XSS Sanitization
controls.description: HTML templates must sanitize user-rendered HTML strings via DOMPurify or framework binding.

controls.name: HTTP-Only Cookie Refresh Tokens
controls.description: Sensitive authentication refresh tokens must be stored in HTTP-Only, Secure, SameSite cookies.

controls.name: Password Hashing Strength
controls.description: Passwords must be hashed with minimum 12 salt rounds of bcrypt or Argon2id.

controls.name: Short-Lived JWT Access Tokens
controls.description: JWT access tokens must expire within 15 minutes.

controls.name: Helmet Security Middleware
controls.description: Server entrypoint must enable Helmet to set HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options.

controls.name: Restricted CORS Whitelist
controls.description: CORS must not allow wildcard origin ('*') with credentials; restrict to explicit domain list.

controls.name: HSTS Enforcement
controls.description: Strict-Transport-Security header must enforce HTTPS for at least 1 year (31536000 seconds).

controls.name: Clean Dependency Audit
controls.description: Application must pass pnpm audit --audit-level high with zero critical or high vulnerabilities.

controls.name: Authentication Rate Limiting
controls.description: Login and password reset endpoints must enforce rate limiting (e.g. 5 requests/minute).

controls.name: Deterministic pnpm Lockfile
controls.description: Repository must maintain pnpm-lock.yaml and exclude npm or yarn lockfiles.

controls.name: Error Stack Leaking Prevention
controls.description: Production HTTP exception responses must sanitize stack traces and internal error payloads.
